name: codex-hud
description: Local eight-line HUD for the active Codex CLI session

interface.shortDescription: Show live Codex session telemetry beside Codex
interface.longDescription: Adds an opt-in, local-only eight-line HUD for the current Codex account and session. macOS standalone Ghostty uses a native split; tmux panes remain the fallback for nested tmux and non-Ghostty terminals. It displays official-parity context pressure, tool and subagent activity, Todo progress, cache usage, estimated API-equivalent cost, quotas, and elapsed session time.
